name: agent-readiness-module-tests
description: Build-output assertion suite for the agent-readiness Hugo module, run against the published files that fourteen hugo builds produce: the fixture with every content-license key unset, the same fixture with them set, a minimal build configuring almost nothing (the shape a consumer gets on import), a build with the twins switched off site-wide while the markdown format stays wired, a two-language build that reaches the agent-skills default-language gate, a build with llms.txt off while its format stays wired, an edge build carrying a subpath baseURL and the remaining misconfigurations, a build with every switch off, a build carrying the malformed table shapes TOML cannot express alongside valid ones, a build with the whole agent namespace written as a bare value, a build layering section_pages = false over the default configuration, a shadowing fixture that ships its own layouts/robots.txt, a paginated fixture whose single section spills past pagerSize, and a widgets fixture whose single page calls every widget shortcode. The module ships zero JavaScript, so there is no browser behavior to test.
